runtime_launch_state: The repository working tree was clean at source revision cd3b6f4ec45994b5cf1151b350476eac7cc0abfc when the B550 capture launched; only ignored build helpers existed. The documented dirty scope is the receipt authoring state after capture.
purpose: Capture a prompt-position routed-expert activation trace and test whether the existing normal batched prefill path reaches the host routing callback.

capture.method: Fresh single-request serve.server process on loopback port 18803, with --short-read 16384 forcing every fresh text segment through verify windows
capture.route_override_environment: The capture helper did not set STRATA_CKPT_REREAD, STRATA_PIPELINE_SWITCH, STRATA_ADMIT_MERGE_FIRST, STRATA_ROUTE_*, or STRATA_LOGPOS; a post-run noninteractive SSH probe also found them absent. A full child-environment blob was not retained.
capture.gpus_after_capture: Both B550 GPUs idle and no Strata engine/server process remained.

trace.weight_payload: All 6,729,600 float weights are zero; the serve callback contract interprets them as unit routed activations.

batched_prefill_negative_control.method: Direct one-shot engine run over 13,964 raw token IDs with normal batched prefill and max-new 1
batched_prefill_negative_control.interpretation: Normal batched prefill did not emit prompt-position records into the current host routing callback; the 48 records are the final generation window, not the 13,963 prefilled positions.

interpretation.prompt_breadth: The prompt touched 23,813 of 24,576 possible layer/expert pairs. A top-activation mask of 256 experts per layer covered only 92.3075% of prompt routed activations.
interpretation.decode_comparison: The earlier 25-record decode-only trace showed 92.0833% coverage at 64 experts per layer; this 14,020-token prompt trace shows 55.6081% at the same count. Decode-only coverage must not select a prompt-state mask alone.
interpretation.decode_mask_control: Applying the exact deterministic top-64 mask selected from the earlier decode trace to this prompt trace covered 995,768 of 6,729,600 routed activations, or 14.7968%.
interpretation.remaining_seam: This is a forced verify-window prompt-position diagnostic, not a literal trace of the normal multi-token batched Prefill::run routing path. A batched-prefill routing capture seam is still required for exact path coverage and true router weights.

validation.result: All six planner runs accepted 672,960 records with exactly 14,020 per layer and reproduced the exact integer coverage numerators and denominator above.

validation.command: parse both binary traces with strict struct.unpack_from validation
validation.result: Serve trace: 48 layers, 14,020 records each, k=10, all weights zero. Negative control: 48 layers, one record each, k=10.

validation.command: rank the durable decode trace with the planner's (-score, expert-id) tie order and replay its top-64 mask over the prompt trace
validation.result: 995,768 of 6,729,600 prompt routed activations covered, exactly 14.79683785068949%.
Machine ID matched; GPU0 used 1 MiB, GPU1 used 33 MiB, both 0% utilization, and no Strata process remained.

non_claims: The forced verify-window path is not the normal batched Prefill::run path and its timing is not a prefill performance measurement.
The callback does not surface router weights, so all coverage here is routed-activation coverage.
One real 40,000-byte source document plus a nonce is not a representative many-agent prompt corpus.
Activation coverage does not predict KL, perplexity, answer quality, or acceptable pruning.

The raw prompt negative control and chat-template forced capture have different token counts; the negative control proves only that normal batched prefill emitted no prompt records to the existing callback.
No default runtime, installer, engine behavior, or pruning artifact changed.
